meeting.type: Special Session — Budget Assumptions Work Session
meeting.summary: Finance Director walked Council through proposed budget assumptions: property-tax revenue per capita, the 3% wage placeholder, Mayor/Council compensation, URS contribution change, and the impact of City growth on department staffing. Significant discussion on Sheriff's Department staffing (goal of one officer per 1,800 residents), bringing the City Attorney in-house, and adding an executive management analyst and content-marketing writer.
